title: Another site's write through MCP, tried in a browser
steps: Open a new tab at about:blank (a page with no policy of its own: a site whose policy limits connect-src would block the fetch itself and prove nothing). In its console, run fetch("<this Preview>/mcp", { method: "POST", mode: "no-cors", headers: { "Content-Type": "text/plain" }, body: JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "write_file", arguments: { path: "From elsewhere.md", text: "x", base: 0 } } }) }). DevTools > Network shows the POST reached the Preview and was answered 403, and no note called From elsewhere appears here. (A no-cors request can only be a GET, HEAD or POST, which is why this goes through MCP.)
